pr_title: Visit ephemeral containers when calculating fs user
pr_body:

#### What type of PR is this?

/kind cleanup
/sig storage

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Ephemeral containers are skipped when visiting containers to calculate fs user for projected volumes because ephemeral containers previously could not specificy a security context. This is no longer true.

This change is currently a no-op since fs user is calculated at pod creation when ephemeral containers may not be specified, but it's worth correcting in case either of these change.

issue_context.title: Cleanup: projected volumes exclude ephemeral containers
issue_context.body:
projected volumes exclude ephemeral containers in calculating fs user because "SecurityContext is not allowed" :

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/0ade4678a7ba527d22f6baa81034dea423267608/pkg/volume/util/util.go#L625-L626

This is no longer technically correct -- ephemeral containers are allowed to specify security context -- but it's a no-op because `ephemeralContainers` is guaranteed to be empty at pod creation when fs user is calculated. Still, the comment is wrong so let's clean it up to avoid confusion.

/kind cleanup
